prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, new_flow] Waiting room companion mini game flow: Adds an interactive pet feeding mini-game flow directly on the waiting screen while pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Your pet is hatching! Feed it treats while you wait.", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_egg_hatching", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Give Treat", "action": "play", "style": "rounded"}]}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom pet sound preview screen: Adds a dedicated pet sound selection screen where users can choose their companion's vocal personality before finalizing adoption.
   config: {"new_pet_sounds": {"headline": "Choose your pet's sound personality", "body": "Listen to voice samples and pick how your desktop companion sounds.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Play Sample", "action": "play", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Confirm Voice", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_sounds", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Choose path interactive storybook redesign: Redesigns the story and path selection flow into a cohesive story_scroll layout with animated visual cards.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet World", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:welcome_mascot", "style": "playful"}]}, "choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Select Your Adventure Path", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose Companion Type", "action": "choose", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Sign in placement shift after story: Moves sign_in to appear immediately after the story intro before choose_path.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "sign_in", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing account pet recovery sign in copy: Updates the sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that signing in restores existing pets and saved items.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign in to keep or restore your pets", "body": "Logging into your existing account will automatically sync and bring back all your previously adopted desktop pets."}}
5: [home, notification] Desktop audio alert on pet ready: Plays a playful chime sound when the pet finishes rendering on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:ready_chime", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption certificate badge unlock: Displays an official adoption badge component on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet creation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Certified Owner", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen background activity status tips: Adds an automated tip carousel to the waiting screen detailing background setup steps and desktop pet behavior facts.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Did you know? Your pet sleeps when your computer goes idle.", "style": "calm"}]}}
8: [finish, layout] Desktop pet control summary layout: Switches home_intro layout to spotlight mode with explicit control cheat-sheet cards explaining desktop interactions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or feed it.", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
9: [finish, hint] Desktop pet visibility hint on home intro: Adds a hint on the finish screen explaining how to bring the pet back to focus if hidden behind full-screen windows.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Can't see your pet? Check your system tray or press Alt+P to summon it to the top layer."}}

verdicts.reason: Valid addition to waiting screen while retaining pet creation status.
Valid addition of a new customization screen within onboarding flow.
Redesign of choose path screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly allowed.
Copy update on sign-in screen complies with all base rules.
Adding audio notification to waiting screen is allowed under Rule 4.
Replaces the required official stamp on the adoption certificate with a badge component.
Adding tips and wait time estimate to waiting screen is allowed.
Redesigning home_intro layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a visibility hint to home_intro is allowed.
